senses.gloss: (אָגַר) (√אג, akin to חכר; v. foreg.) prop. to tie, whence to hire, employ, rent.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:16">Targ. Gen. XXX, 16</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:6">Koh. R. to IV, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:1">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> beg. (prov.) <he>גינא וכ׳ דא׳</he> he who rents one garden will eat birds; him who rents gardens, the birds will eat.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:6">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מיגר זנייתא</he> hiring prostitutes.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 23:5">Targ. Y. Deut. XXIII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 23:4">4</cite>).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a">B. Mets. 77ᵃ</cite> (interch. with Pe.) (<he>אגירי</he>) <he>אוגיר אגורי</he> engages laborers.
<cite ref="Eruvin 63b:11">Erub. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹגַר לן רשותך</he> lease to us thy property. Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵇ top. Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ bot. <he>אוגרית חמרי</he> I hired my ass out.

senses.gloss: (contr. of איתאגר) to be hired, to work as a laborer.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 23:25">Targ. O. Deut. XXIII, 25</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Yoma 20b:6">Yoma 20ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>אי תגרת וכ׳</he> (combine into one w.) when thou hast hired thyself out to one, comb his wool (shrink from no labor).
